title: Snoozy Quinn, Sharkey and Bix at the Palmer House
summary: Sal tells of Snoozy Quinn's guitar playing and says he heard Bix Beiderbecke in Chicago.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Bix Beiderbecke: hearing, copying and remembering him

blocks.x: You never tell him about Snoozy?

Ah, Snoozy Quinn? Never heard of him. Well, because he knew all about him. No, tell me about him. She wanted me to tell you what I know about him, see. We know that you know about Snoozy. Well, here's Snoozy Quinn. I know you, because he goes into the history and all the other stuff. But I know him too, and I didn't go into it. Well, I was living there then. Yeah, you were there. Right. Snoozy Quinn, see. He was delivering meat, you know. Buckaloosa, riding bicycle, see.

I had that, you know. Deformed, you know, Snoozy. And he heard the band. Of course I wasn't there because if it stopped, I was there. I'd be lying, I don't lie. He was living on meat there. I mean, Shocker was playing Spongebber over there, in Buckaloosa. And it was Snoozy, I got to his back to hit a band, you know. And that's how he talked, you know. He said, yeah, you all have a good band, man. That's Snoozy talk, you know. So, Shocker talked to the guy, he said, punk, you know. So, while I come in, it was late. I didn't know him, I didn't know him, Buckaloosa. I knew him here. When he came here, he said, for a dance hall, man. He sat in. And the first time I heard a guy play like that. He'd take a guitar like that when he'd lick like that. Like boom, like that, man. He'd keep playing on the guitar. I said, gee, wait a minute, this guy's great. First thing you know, white in his band, man. He'd come down here, took a guitar, played a hit, picked a throw, and hung back. A banjo player, and him on the guitar, Snoozy. And George Morris was playing drums, and go over there on trumpet. Bix was playing my fourth trumpet. Bix couldn't read too much, you know that. I'd see another hand later, I'd say, I'd talk to him like he does. Jim McFartner, you know that, Mike Faulkner. I was working at the Palmer House, man. I got a scene with him. I got a scene with him.
